# Requirements of the export tool — groups

The hierarchy of the requirements, one group per list item, each member by its name in capitals. A group has
no identifier; a requirement not listed here is shown at the top level.

- Identity
  - EVERY EXPORT HAS A NAME
  - Naming
    - A NAME, WITH A COMMA
    - Owners
      - THE AUTHOR'S OWN EXPORT
- Formats
  - EXPORT AS CSV
- Withdrawn
  - EXPORT AS PDF
